title: My Youth Romantic Comedy Is Wrong, As I Expected @ comic
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Hachiman Hikigaya is a cynical loner who believes 'youth' is an illusion built on failure and hypocrisy. He is forced into a school club with the brilliant but icy Yukino Yukinoshita, and the two misfits are tasked with solving fellow students' problems. A manga adaptation of Wataru Watari's light novels about loneliness, honesty and friendship.
life_message: Genuine connection requires honesty and the risk of being hurt, not cynicism or social pretense.

content.note: Loneliness and social isolation (MU Loner, Social Outcast).

dominant: Cynicism versus genuine connection; honesty; loneliness
